objects.description: [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has used the `EnumSystemLocalesW` function to enumerate installed or supported locales on the victim machine.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has also used a GET request to ip-api[.]com, resolving the victim's public IP address and country.(Citation: Unit42_Vidar_July2026)
